decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the erection of a single storey rear extension, as shown on drawing numbers 0257/01, 02, 03, 04, 05 and 06, received 13th January 2006, is recommended for approval as it is considered that the conservatory by reason of its size, materials and design would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of Number 9 Huntingdon Gardens, Chiswick. The conservatory would preserve the character of the Conservation Area and would not be detrimental to the surrounding properties. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003) and is compliant with Councils residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The south and south west facing  elevation shall be formed with solid, non opening panels and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with solid panels.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the south west facing wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear conservatory to house ( Chiswick house conservation area)
